source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Attached are the Excel template and additional project information for your review, Elias. We are currently preparing a financial model for government submission in connection with a potential PPP project.

For the project to be viable and bankable, a key requirement is that the model clearly demonstrate and justify the need for availability-style payments. Please confirm whether you can support us in developing it. There may be errors that need checking, and we also need the finished model to look professional, clear, and strongly presented.

value_updates.required_demonstration: Clearly demonstrate and justify that availability-style payments are needed to make the project viable and bankable.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Although the model is being finalized, its figures remain projections. At this stage, the main objective is to give the government sufficiently robust financial evidence that an availability-style payment is necessary. The model must clearly show that user fees alone cannot make the project viable or bankable.

value_updates.user_fee_only_conclusion: The model must clearly show that user fees alone cannot make the project viable or bankable.
value_updates.evidence_standard: Provide sufficiently robust financial evidence for the government that an availability-style payment is necessary.
